purpose: Falsification-first shadow fixture for contract authority/drift, joint-authority admission, action-contract fidelity, dependency-local refresh, and identity current-target lookup.

governing_procedures.prose_text: Before publishing, require a clean tree, read the current head, run the public integrity gate, never force-push, and verify the remote head afterward.
For public release publication, also record public evidence after the integrity gate.
For EU deployment, also run the EU deployment check.

authority_evidence.rationale: The three peer procedures govern as one all-members-required set; no participant has precedence or directional ownership over the others.
Both procedures apply in EU, but N2 explicitly specializes N1.

changes.prose_text_append: Also require a signed release note before publication.
